extension.name: ToothOps PIMS
extension.description: Writes your ToothOps record notes into the open PIMS consult.

install.title: The ToothOps PIMS extension isn’t responding
install.body: Make sure the ToothOps PIMS extension is installed and enabled in Chrome, then try again. If you don’t have it yet, contact ToothOps support for the install link.

noTab: Open the consult in PIMS, then try again.
severalTabs: Several PIMS tabs are open. Using: {{title}}

state.notConsult: ToothOps can’t verify the active encounter, so sending is disabled. Open a supported consult or copy the notes manually.
state.notMedicalTab: Open the Medical tab of the consult, then try again.
state.locked: This consult is locked in PIMS. Open an unlocked consult, then try again.
state.combined: ezyVet is in Combined view. Switch to Standard view, then try again.

editedNotice: The note was edited, so it can’t be split back into its sections. It will be sent as one block.

actions.diagnosticCopied: Diagnostic report copied. Paste it into your message to ToothOps support.

mismatch.title: Different patient?
mismatch.messageNumbers: The chart is for {{chart}} (number {{chartNumber}}), but PIMS shows {{ezyvet}} (number {{ezyvetNumber}}).

alreadySent.title: Already sent on {{date}}. Send again?
alreadySent.message: Sending again adds a second copy in PIMS.

results.title: Results
results.stampFailed: Sent, but ToothOps couldn’t record the send date on this chart.

errors.extension_error: ToothOps couldn’t reach the ToothOps PIMS extension. Check that it is installed and enabled, then try again.
errors.timeout: The extension didn’t answer in time. Check the PIMS tab and try again.
errors.no_tab: The PIMS tab was closed. Open the consult in PIMS and try again.
errors.not_writable: The consult can no longer be written to because it is locked, closed or the active encounter can’t be verified. Open a supported, unlocked consult and try again, or copy the notes manually.
errors.patient_changed: A different patient or consult is now open in PIMS, so nothing more was sent. Open the right consult and try again.
errors.field_not_found: This field isn’t on the consult page. Choose another field under Where it goes.
errors.editor_not_found: ToothOps couldn’t find this field’s text box. Check the field in PIMS before sending again. If it keeps failing, copy the diagnostic report for ToothOps support.
errors.popup_not_found: This field’s editing window didn’t open. Check the field in PIMS before sending again. If it keeps failing, copy the diagnostic report for ToothOps support.
errors.popup_not_closed: This field’s editing window didn’t close after saving. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.save_button_not_found: ToothOps couldn’t find the Save button for this field. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.save_not_confirmed: PIMS didn’t confirm the save. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.no_preferred_email: The client has no preferred email address in PIMS. Add one, or choose another field.
errors.image_not_accepted: This field doesn’t accept pictures. Choose a field that accepts pictures.
errors.invalid_image: The chart picture couldn’t be prepared. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.picture_failed: ToothOps couldn’t draw the chart picture, so it wasn’t sent.
errors.maybe_sent: Some fields may already have been written. Check the consult in PIMS before sending again.
errors.item_extension_error: Something went wrong while writing this field. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.item_not_writable: The consult stopped accepting changes because it is locked, closed or the active encounter can’t be verified, so this field wasn’t sent. Check the consult in your practice software before sending again.
errors.item_patient_changed: A different patient or consult was opened in PIMS, so this field wasn’t sent. Check the consult in PIMS before sending again.

panel.notConnected: This build isn’t connected to ToothOps.

signIn.title: Sign in to ToothOps
signIn.lead: Send record notes from your ToothOps charts into the open PIMS consult.

list.matchCount: {{matches}} charts match this patient. Showing the most recent.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by patient, owner or number

chart.flagLoading: Checking whether sending is on for your practice…
chart.flagFailed: Couldn’t check whether sending to PIMS is turned on for your practice.
chart.sendOff: Sending to PIMS isn’t turned on for your practice.

today.title: Today’s patients (PIMS)
today.loadHint: This may switch your practice software to the calendar.
today.noTab: Open PIMS to see today’s patients.
today.empty: No patients on today’s PIMS schedule.

errors.no_dashboard: The dashboard in your practice software couldn’t be found.
errors.no_date_input: The date in your practice software’s calendar couldn’t be set.
errors.no_calendar_refresh: Your practice software’s calendar isn’t responding. Reload your practice software and try again.
errors.unknown: Today’s schedule couldn’t be read from your practice software.
errors.read_failed: Today’s schedule couldn’t be read from your practice software. Check the calendar and try again.

send.targetChanged: The PIMS consult changed. Check the target and press Send again.

handover.filled: Patient details filled in from PIMS.
handover.failed: Couldn’t get the patient from PIMS. Fill in the details.
handover.otherUser: This patient was picked in the extension as another user. Sign in with the same account in both.
